import sys, json, hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'tools'))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.lint import extract_format_tokens, MARKUP_RE, AT_TOKEN_RE
root=Path.cwd(); temp=Path(__file__).parent
changes=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003/CHANGES.json').read_text())
allowed=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003/SCOPE.json').read_text())['allowed_files']
assert len(changes)==16 and set(c['file'] for c in changes)==set(allowed)
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
before={f:(root/f).read_bytes() for f in allowed}
docs={f:loader.load_bytes(b,logical_path=f).records for f,b in before.items()}
for f,b in before.items(): (temp/f).write_bytes(b)
(temp/'baseline-status.txt').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short']))
(temp/'baseline-diff.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff']))
results=[]; edits={f:[] for f in allowed}
for c in changes:
    f=c['file']; records=docs[f]
    matches=[(i,r) for i,r in enumerate(records) if r.get('kind')=='translation' and r.get('source')==c['source'] and r.get('section')==c['section'] and r.get('source_tag')==c['source_tag']]
    assert len(matches)==1, (c['id'], 'identity',len(matches))
    i,r=matches[0]; assert r['target']==c['old_target'],c['id']
    old,new=c['old_target'],c['new_target']
    if '\n' in old:
        a=('[[ '+old).encode() if False else ('[['+old+']]').encode()
        b=('[['+new+']]').encode()
    else:
        a=json.dumps(old,ensure_ascii=False).encode(); b=json.dumps(new,ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    assert before[f].count(a)==1,(c['id'],'raw target unique')
    pos=before[f].index(a)
    assert [t.raw for t in extract_format_tokens(old)]==[t.raw for t in extract_format_tokens(new)],c['id']
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(old)==MARKUP_RE.findall(new) and AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(old)==AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new),c['id']
    assert old.count('\n')==new.count('\n'),c['id']
    assert [x for x in old if x in '\r\n\t']==[x for x in new if x in '\r\n\t'],c['id']
    edits[f].append((pos,a,b))
    results.append(dict(id=c['id'],file=f,record_index=c['record_index'],loaded_record_index=i,old_target=old,requested_new_target=new,actual_target=new,status='applied',exact_requested_target=True,placeholder_sequence=[t.raw for t in extract_format_tokens(new)],markup_sequence=MARKUP_RE.findall(new),decoded_newline_count=new.count('\n'),ascii_spacing_deviations=[]))
after={}
for f,els in edits.items():
    b=before[f]
    for pos,a,new in sorted(els,reverse=True):
        assert b[pos:pos+len(a)]==a
        b=b[:pos]+new+b[pos+len(a):]
    after[f]=b
    loaded=loader.load_bytes(b,logical_path=f).records
    assert len(loaded)==len(docs[f]),f
    accepted={r['loaded_record_index']:r for r in results if r['file']==f}
    for i,(old,new) in enumerate(zip(docs[f],loaded)):
        expected=dict(old)
        if i in accepted: expected['target']=accepted[i]['actual_target']
        assert new==expected,(f,i,'fields outside target changed')
    restored=b
    for pos,a,new in sorted(els):
        assert restored[pos:pos+len(new)]==new
        restored=restored[:pos]+a+restored[pos+len(new):]
    assert restored==before[f],(f,'outside target bytes')
# Only write after all sixteen candidates and complete semantic/byte checks pass.
for f,b in after.items(): (root/f).write_bytes(b)
report=dict(task_id='awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003',role='executor',status='implemented_pending_lint',results=results,deviations=[],notes=['SCAN-04: authorized deletion removes literal 25%%; argument-consuming format-token sequence remains %0.2f.'],invariants=dict(target_count=16,only_allowed_target_bytes_changed=True,all_non_target_fields_unchanged=True,all_other_records_unchanged=True,placeholder_sequences_unchanged=True,markup_sequences_unchanged=True,newline_and_tab_sequences_unchanged=True),file_hashes={f:dict(before=hashlib.sha256(before[f]).hexdigest(),after=hashlib.sha256(after[f]).hexdigest()) for f in allowed},validation=[])
p=root/'.artifacts/i18n/awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003/executor-report.json';p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(applied=len(results),files=allowed,invariants=report['invariants']),ensure_ascii=False))

import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); temp=Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.lint import extract_format_tokens,MARKUP_RE,AT_TOKEN_RE
p=root/'.artifacts/i18n/awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003/executor-report.json'
r=json.loads(p.read_text()); loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
for f,hashes in r['file_hashes'].items():
    before=(temp/f).read_bytes(); after=(root/f).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()==hashes['after']
    old_doc=loader.load_bytes(before,logical_path=f).records
    new_doc=loader.load_bytes(after,logical_path=f).records
    assert len(old_doc)==len(new_doc)
    approved={x['loaded_record_index']:x for x in r['results'] if x['file']==f}
    for i,(old,new) in enumerate(zip(old_doc,new_doc)):
        expected=dict(old)
        if i in approved:
            x=approved[i]; expected['target']=x['requested_new_target']
            assert old['target']==x['old_target']
            assert [t.raw for t in extract_format_tokens(old['target'])]==[t.raw for t in extract_format_tokens(new['target'])]
            assert MARKUP_RE.findall(old['target'])==MARKUP_RE.findall(new['target'])
            assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(old['target'])==AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new['target'])
            assert [c for c in old['target'] if c in '\r\n\t']==[c for c in new['target'] if c in '\r\n\t']
        assert expected==new,(f,i)
    def mask(raw,key):
        for x in approved.values():
            target=x[key]; lit=(('[['+target+']]') if '\n' in target else json.dumps(target,ensure_ascii=False)).encode()
            assert raw.count(lit)==1,(x['id'],key)
            # Keep literal delimiters intact; replace only the target contents.
            width=2 if '\n' in target else 1
            masked=lit[:width]+('<'+x['id']+'>').encode()+lit[-width:]
            raw=raw.replace(lit,masked,1)
        return raw
    assert mask(before,'old_target')==mask(after,'actual_target'),f
other_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','.',*[":(exclude)"+f for f in r['file_hashes']]])
assert other_diff==(temp/'baseline-diff.patch').read_bytes(),'pre-existing diff changed'
base_status=(temp/'baseline-status.txt').read_text().splitlines()
current_status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],text=True).splitlines()
expected_status=set(base_status)|{' M '+f for f in r['file_hashes']}
assert set(current_status)==expected_status,'unexpected worktree file changes'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached'])==b'','index changed'
check=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert check.returncode==0,check.stdout+check.stderr
r['status']='executor_complete'
r['invariants'].update(preexisting_changes_preserved=True,excluded_and_other_records_unchanged=True,independent_final_byte_mask_check=True,index_unchanged=True)

 {'command':'baseline git diff/status comparison; git diff --cached','exit_code':0,'result':'pre-existing user changes retained; only 4 authorized Lua files added to modified set; index unchanged'}]
